$comment: Machine-readable component contracts for the Wyrd design system under the bohmian brand. `status: built` entries are implemented in src/lib/components and registered in src/lib/registry.ts (parity enforced by registry.test.ts); `status: spec` entries are contracted but not yet built and are deliberately excluded from that parity check. The rendered reference is ./renders/styleguide.html. A dynamic-layout/A2UI renderer consumes this file to compose UIs from standardized pieces. Infrastructure (ModeProvider, Drawer) is intentionally absent: it is composed by other components, not placed by name.

altitudes.quiet: workbench default — 3px hard-offset shadow, restrained accent
altitudes.loud: hero / landing only — 10px shadow, tricolor rail, serif display type

ownership.$comment: Blue is primary, lime is secondary. Fathom identity is carried by the ProductPill, the tinted card head, and the label — NOT by owning a colour. See DESIGN.md 'Never colour alone': --ok and --danger collapse to 1.11:1 under deuteranopia, so no meaning in this system may rest on hue alone.
ownership.rule: Bright --lime is a FILL only (1.30:1 on white). Anything that needs lime as a mark — text, a thin bar, the client plane — uses --lime-text.
ownership.redundancy: Status carries a glyph, thresholds carry a tick, chart series carry a dash. Colour is never the sole carrier of a meaning.

rules: 2px border always
3px shadow quiet / 6px shadow raised
5px radius
wide spans grid-column 1 / -1

owner=fathom tints the head color-mix(--lime 26%, --surface), marking the content as Fathom-authored rather than Wyrd's. Its label is --text, NOT --ink-on-fill: the band lands on a dark olive in dark mode where near-black ink falls to 2.12:1.
primary = brand blue fill (--brand-btn) — the one strong action on a surface
secondary = lime fill — the second voice. Fathom-authored actions (open fix PR, re-run verification) use it, but it is NOT reserved to them; any genuine secondary action may take it.
ghost = surface fill, no accent
fill is --brand-btn, never --brand: --brand is a dim navy panel colour in dark and pairs with --brand-btn-ink at 1.23:1
press interaction: hover lifts to 5px, active sinks to 1px
tone is a status signal, not decoration

tone drives border, label, and tint from one --bc custom property, and --bc is always a *-text token: raw --ok/--warn/--danger are fill colours and land at 3.01 / 2.28 / 3.94:1 as an 8.5px label on light
2px border in tone colour, 12% tinted fill, 4px radius

MUST render a glyph before the label — ok=✓ warn=! danger=✕ fathom=◈. --ok and --danger collapse to 1.11:1 under deuteranopia, so a colour-only badge makes pass and fail identical for ~6% of men. DriftPanel's .chk .ic already did this; Badge matches it.
neutral takes no tint: 'neutral' means no status, and a 12% --muted wash lands at 4.46:1 in dark, which the contrast contract rejects
header is plain surface (not gray) relying on the 2px bottom border
selection wash uses --brand-soft (tr.sel), never lime
2px row dividers, last row borderless
value is set in --font-display (Space Grotesk 700), not the body face
delta trend up = --ok, down = --danger
min-width:0 + overflow:hidden so wide values never blow out a grid track
inline SVG 300x148, bar fill from a kind/line token, value + category labels
inline SVG 300x148, multi-series, dashed gridlines
series stroke from kind tokens: p50 --control-bar, p95 --brand-strong, p99 --danger

each series MUST carry a distinct stroke-dasharray (p50 solid, p95 '6 3', p99 '2 3') and the legend MUST mirror it as a line sample, not a block swatch. --control-bar and --brand-strong collapse to 1.22:1 under deuteranopia, so hue alone cannot separate p50 from p95.
90x24 polyline, no fill, color = trend sentiment
326x116 grouped reference (control) vs current (brand blue) distribution bars
326x104 line with dashed danger threshold; points above threshold turn danger
CSS grid of color-mix cells, not SVG
intensity ramp uses brand blue (--brand-strong), NEVER lime — lime cannot darken on white
stacked plane distribution using the Line colors + legend
native details/summary, 3px kind left-bar on leaves, dashed nested guide
2px border menu, 3px shadow, selected option brand-soft wash + brand-strong tick
mono surface-2 block, 2px border, 5px radius
optional copy button via navigator.clipboard
op left-bar by span kind (agent=client olive, llm=brand blue, tool=server amber, retrieval=control steel); status column ok/warn/err
raw values in (durationMs/tokens/cost numbers, score 0-1, scoreTone verdict); formatted internally via lib/format.ts
ruler + positioned span bars; bar = kind border + color-mix kind tint; error overrides to danger
raised drawer, top-bar = span kind color, kv attributes + event timeline + code preview
token counts are raw numbers, humanized via lib/format.ts
raised drawer, big score, metric bars vs threshold (ok/danger), judge rationale

each metric bar MUST draw a threshold tick (--thr as a percentage) — a 2px rule at the server-owned threshold. Without it 'did this pass' rests on bar hue alone, and --ok/--danger are 1.11:1 under deuteranopia. The tick makes it a positional read.
the threshold is policy (server-owned); the tick position and the redness are presentation (UI)
raised drawer, top-bar turns --danger when drifted (status overrides kind), histogram + trend
212px sidebar + topbar + main grid; 3px outer border
nav groups; active item brand-soft wash + border + 2px shadow
brand slot is the bohmian mark (logo.svg) followed by the lowercase 'bohmian' wordmark in --font-serif
kind left-bars use the Line tokens and always sit beside a text label
breadcrumb + search + env pill with status dot
hosts the ProductPill immediately after the wordmark
serif display type (--font-serif Fraunces), 3px border, 10px shadow, tricolor rail; landing only, never beside the workbench
uppercase --font-mono, 10px, 700, .08em tracking
wyrd = --brand-btn fill + --brand-btn-ink; fathom = --lime fill + --lime-ink
the fill is --brand-btn, NOT --brand: --brand is a dim navy panel colour in dark mode and pairs with --brand-btn-ink at 1.23:1. --brand-btn holds ≥6.5:1 in both modes.
2px border, 3px radius — sits immediately after the bohmian wordmark in the Topbar
names the product layer the current surface belongs to; it is identity, never a control

props.nodes: Array<{ label: string, kind: string, hot?: boolean }>

rules: the record behind the current surface: nodes joined left-to-right by arrowed --brand-strong edges
--brand-soft band background; each node is a 2px-bordered surface tile with a 2px hard shadow
node label is --font-mono 700; the kind caption below it is uppercase --muted
hot node (the one the current view is about) takes a --brand-strong border
min-width:max-content inside overflow-x:auto — the chain scrolls, it never wraps or truncates
spans the full width at the bottom of a surface; it is context, not a primary control
